hooks.command: [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" ] && [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && { echo "export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; echo "export PATH=$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/bin:\$PATH" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; bash "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/bootstrap.sh" & } || true
